label: Overhead per call
subgoals: Add the crossing cost to the per-element kernel cost
Divide the crossing cost by the total per element
Note that per-element calls also block vectorization

label: Batching the call
subgoals: Divide the element count by the batch size and round up
Multiply the crossings by the crossing cost
Express the overhead as a share of kernel time

label: Choosing a batch size
subgoals: Set crossing cost over batch size at most x times kernel cost
Solve for the batch size and round up
Check the batch against the boundary's natural unit
